title: CMS CONSULTING: Combining precision, quality and social responsibility in cosmetic packaging
summary: Czech-based CMS CONSULTING offers flexible, high-quality secondary packaging and assembly solutions for the cosmetics industry, combining specialist expertise with a strong commitment to sustainability and inclusive employment
